# Marie Claire UK

> > Marie Claire UK is a women's fashion and lifestyle magazine featuring runway coverage, beauty advice, and curated shopping deals with exclusive discount codes.

The site provides fashion editorial content alongside a comprehensive vouchers section offering verified discount codes for fashion, beauty, travel, and lifestyle brands. Content is produced by Marie Claire UK's editorial team including Becky Spicer and Shona Moreland, with special focus on student, NHS, and key worker savings.

## Key Topics

- Fashion deals and discount codes
- Student discounts (Student Beans, UNiDAYS)
- NHS and Blue Light Card offers
- Beauty and skincare vouchers
- Travel promo codes
- Black Friday sales
- Free delivery offers
- Luxury fashion brands
- High street fashion
- Money-saving tips
- Returns policies
- Newsletter exclusive deals
- Key worker discounts
- Loyalty programmes
- Payment options (Clearpay, Klarna)
